observations: The reconstructed top has broad softly rounded fitted cyan stones, restrained blue/lavender accents and clear relief. It is a useful native improvement over the original blank folded loft and black triangular intrusion.

The exact actual shader normal field, albedo, short W/N collars and native cap behavior satisfy the explicit v2 equivalence contract. Geometric custom-normal storage differs and is separately recorded; it is not a reason to reject this implementation.

The S/W outside side remains a broad smooth cyan strip with an isolated dark vertical smudge. This is visible in the actual2x heroes, at logical128 and in native/consumer family assemblies on all3 backgrounds; it reads as an unfinished side and a blemish, weakening the agreed layered stone volume.

Both current consumer configurations completed276 cases without page errors. Source native canvases agree, while final CSS filtering/color rounding differs; full-image cross-browser or native-versus-independent pixel identity is not claimed.
